//.effect: The CLI is an effect/cli command tree over the engine's services; prompts are effect/cli's Prompt over Effect's Terminal, whose one reader of stdin also feeds pasted sign-in addresses.
//.@effect/platform-bun: BunRuntime.runMain and BunServices (file system, paths, processes, stdio, terminal) under the binary; only src/main.ts imports it.
//.@slopmax/core: The engine: every command calls its services in process, or the running proxy through its typed API client.
//.@slopmax/domain: The shapes `status --json`, `usage --json`, `doctor --json`, `start --json` and `service status --json` print, the provider and agent facts the choices come from, and the people-facing formats.
//.@slopmax/test: it.effect / it.live and TestHome for the tests.
//.build: build.ts builds the web UI (apps/ui), writes src/embedded.ts listing its files for the binary, compiles with Bun canary's ahead-of-time compiler (compile: `bun compile --trim`) or without it (build: `--no-aot --minify --bytecode`, the fallback), and puts the stub embedded.ts back.
//.budget: Measured 2026-10-31 on linux-x64 with 1.4.4-canary.1+da867c60b (docs/AOT.md, "The slopmax binary"): the AOT binary 71,284,968 bytes (budget 70 MiB), 23.9 MB as xz (26 MB), --version 22 ms (30 ms); the daemon idle at 58 MB and peaking at 153 MB, over its 45 and 120 MB.
